findings.evidence: Basic.lean:838-843 `lemma apply_self_of_isF1F2Decomposition_of_spectator ... (hqe : g K.q e = 0) (hTe : g (pTransverse g K) e = 0) : W e e = -g e e * F1`; Basic.lean:787 `fromF1F2_isDecomposition`.
findings.fix: Derive it: `apply_self_of_isF1F2Decomposition_of_spectator g K (fromF1F2_isDecomposition g K F1 F2) heq heT` for the even part plus `hA.self_eq_zero` for `c • A`. No import change is needed (both are in `Hadronic` in `Tensors/Basic.lean`).
findings.issue: `fromF1F2_add_smul_apply_self_of_spectator` re-proves, by unfolding `fromF1F2_apply`/`transverseMetric_apply`, the special case `W = fromF1F2 g K F1 F2` of the existing general lemma `Hadronic.apply_self_of_isF1F2Decomposition_of_spectator` (Basic.lean:838, `W e e = -g e e * F1` for any `IsF1F2Decomposition`), with the same `heq`/`heT` hypotheses.

findings.evidence: Longitudinal.lean:280-288 and 229-232; Longitudinal.lean:8 `public import EpsilonEridani.QFT.Factorization.DIS.LO`, so `Decomposition` cannot simply import it.
findings.fix: Hoist `transverseMetric_pTransverse_self` and `apply_pTransverse_self` to `Tensors/Basic.lean` next to the other `IsF1F2Decomposition` value lemmas, and derive `fromF1F2_add_smul_apply_pTransverse` from the hoisted lemma plus `hA.self_eq_zero`; `Longitudinal` then uses the hoisted versions.
findings.issue: `fromF1F2_add_smul_apply_pTransverse` likewise re-proves `Longitudinal.apply_pTransverse_self` (Longitudinal.lean:280-288: `W pT pT = g pT pT * (F2c * g pT pT - F1)` for any decomposed `W`, under the same `hSymm`, `hQ2`) specialized to `fromF1F2`. The general lemma and its input `transverseMetric_pTransverse_self` (Longitudinal.lean:229) are pure `IsF1F2Decomposition`/`transverseMetric` facts stranded in `Longitudinal`, which additionally imports `QFT.Factorization.DIS.LO`.

findings.evidence: Spectators.lean:201-203, proof is `div_pos_iff.mpr (mul_pos_iff.mp hsign)`; `hP` appears only in the statement's scalars.
findings.fix: Either inline `div_pos_iff.mpr (mul_pos_iff.mp hsign)` at the three call sites, or state it generally as `{a b : ℝ} (h : 0 < a * b) : 0 < a / b` (Mathlib has no `div_pos_of_mul_pos`; `div_pos_iff` is Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Field/Basic.lean:576).
findings.issue: `SpectatorPair.div_pos_of_mul_pos` takes a `SpectatorPair` argument that the proof never uses: the content is the real-number fact `0 < a * b → 0 < a / b`, stated only at `a = g e₁ e₁`, `b = g e₂ e₂`, so it cannot be reused anywhere else.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:220-248; `grep 'lemma reflect_'` in Basic.lean shows only `reflect_apply`, `reflect_apply_self`, `reflect_apply_of_orthogonal`, `reflect_isometry`, i.e. no involution lemma to reduce the second case to the first.
findings.fix: Add the general reflection fact the `Bilin` API is missing — involutivity, `reflect g u (reflect g u v) = v` for `g.IsSymm`, `g u u ≠ 0` — and get `reflect_sub_apply_right` from `reflect_sub_apply_left` in one line.
findings.issue: `Bilin.reflect_sub_apply_right` is a 12-line near-copy of `reflect_sub_apply_left` (lines 220-232) with the signs flipped; both are halves of the single fact that `reflect g (u - u')` swaps `u` and `u'`.

summary: The main decomposition theorems sit at the right level (no symmetry on W, A only assumed parity-odd and non-zero, injectivity stated with the weak `A e e' ≠ 0`), but three of the new helper lemmas re-prove special cases of facts the repo already proves in general, and one is a structure-level wrapper around a pure real-number fact.
